doc.brief: The possible values for the %GTK_ACCESSIBLE_PROPERTY_SORT accessible property.
doc.md:
The possible values for the %GTK_ACCESSIBLE_PROPERTY_SORT
accessible property.

ascending.brief: Items are sorted in ascending order by this column.
ascending.md: Items are sorted in ascending order by this column.

descending.brief: Items are sorted in descending order by this column.
descending.md: Items are sorted in descending order by this column.

none.brief: There is no defined sort applied to the column.
none.md: There is no defined sort applied to the column.

other.brief: A sort algorithm other than ascending or descending has been applied.
other.md:
A sort algorithm other than ascending or
   descending has been applied.
